title: Counterterrorism Education Learning Lab

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Explore the CELL Exhibit’s immersive experience investigating the root causes of violent extremism and learn how to help prevent future threats. Through interactive displays and multimedia presentations, you’ll see how world leaders use language as a weapon and how state-sponsored terrorism affects both domestic and global security. Join us on Sept. 18 for an SCFD Free Day of learning and empowerment. Be vigilant through everyday scenario simulations and become a champion of change for a safer, more inclusive community.
